#### `def iterate_instructions(code_object)` (Línea 5)
- **Propósito:** Delivers the byte-code instructions as a continuous stream.

Yields `dis.Instruction`. After each code-block (`co_code`), `None` is
yielded to mark the end of the block and to interrupt the steam.
- **Firma:** `def iterate_instructions(code_object)`
